title: Connecting Extreme-Point Generation and Decision Rules in Two-Stage Distributionally Robust Optimization
summary: Two-stage distributionally robust optimization chooses a here-and-now decision and a wait-and-see decision policy that adapts to uncertainty realizations. Decision-rule methods specify the form of this adaptive policy in advance, whereas decomposition-generation methods construct second-stage value information iteratively. We connect these approaches through extreme points of the second-stage dual problem. Each extreme point defines an affine value piece, and a compatible primal basis can define an affine policy piece.
